description: Synthetic X-bookmark-style posts for overlapping-tag diagnostics. Written for Jet on 2026-09-28 with gold tags fixed before any model run. Development may inform prompts; thresholds are chosen on calibration only; held_out is scored once. Not user data and not a claim about real bookmark accuracy.
